Class EmailLoader

java.lang.Object
EmailLoader
public class EmailLoader extends Object
Loads the text files of the emails and converts them to the ARFF format that Weka can use. Using Weka's TextDirectoryLoader, the text files of a directory structure are read automatically, where each folder corresponds to one class (for example: spam / legitimate). The generated dataset has two main attributes:
  • Text (the content of the email)
  • Class (spam or legitimate)
The final result is saved in an ARFF file for the following processing steps (to be used in the final pipeline). This class is the first step of the email classification system.

The result does not depend on the operating system: the files are read as UTF-8, the class labels are sorted alphabetically and the emails are sorted by class and file name (Weka's loader alone uses the order in which the file system lists the folders, and the default charset of the platform).

    • saveToArff

      public static void saveToArff(weka.core.Instances data, File outputFile) throws Exception
      Saves a dataset to an ARFF file.

      If they do not exist, this method creates the directories of the output file, and writes the data using Weka's ArffSaver.

      Parameters:
      data - Instances object to save
      outputFile - File object of the output file
      Throws:
      Exception - If an error happens while writing the file

    • ensureClassIndex

      public static void ensureClassIndex(weka.core.Instances data)
      Makes sure that the class attribute of a dataset is the last attribute.

      Weka needs the class attribute to be set explicitly for most processes. This method only changes it if it is not set, making the last attribute the class.

      Parameters:
      data - Dataset to process

    • sanitizeAttributeNames

      public static void sanitizeAttributeNames(weka.core.Instances data)

      Parameters:

    • makeDeterministic

      public static weka.core.Instances makeDeterministic(weka.core.Instances data, String relationName) throws Exception
      Puts a dataset loaded with TextDirectoryLoader (with the file name attribute enabled) in a fixed order, so that the result is the same on every operating system.
      • The labels of the class attribute are sorted alphabetically.
      • The emails are sorted by class label and then by file name.
      • The file name attribute is removed.
      • The relation name is the name of the source folder (instead of the absolute path on the computer).
      Parameters:
      data - Dataset with the attributes text, filename and class
      relationName - Relation name of the result
      Returns:
      The dataset in a fixed order, with the attributes text and class
      Throws:
      Exception - If a Weka filter fails

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Main method: loads the text files and converts them into an ARFF dataset.

      The input directory and the output file can be given as arguments. Otherwise, default values are used.

      Parameters:
      args - Command-line arguments:
      • args[0] - Source directory (email texts)
      • args[1] - Output ARFF file
